title: Числа 17 — Numbers 17
instructions: Choose the correct case form of the word in brackets to fill the blank. Every option is a real form of the same word — only the case differs.

cases.explain: After the numeral двенадцать (twelve) the counted noun stands in the genitive plural → жезлов.

cases.sentence: Положи их в ___ собрания перед ковчегом свидетельства.
cases.translation: Place them in the tent of meeting before the ark of the testimony.
cases.explain: The preposition в meaning "in" a location (no motion) takes the prepositional → шатре.

cases.sentence: Положи их в шатре собрания перед ___ свидетельства.
cases.explain: The preposition перед (before / in front of) takes the instrumental → ковчегом.

cases.sentence: Напиши имя каждого ___ на его жезле.
cases.translation: Write the name of each man on his rod.
cases.explain: Possession — "the name of each man" — is expressed by the genitive → человека.
Миндаль is the direct object of принёс (bore); for this inanimate masculine noun the accusative equals the nominative → миндаль.

cases.sentence: Господь сказал ___: положи жезл Аарона обратно.
cases.translation: The Lord said to Moses: put Aaron's rod back.
cases.explain: The dative marks the addressee of сказать ("said to Moses") → Моисею.
Вожди is the subject performing the action (gave) — the doer takes the nominative → вожди (nominative plural).

cases.sentence: Любой, кто даже приблизится к ___ Господа, умрёт.
cases.translation: Anyone who even approaches the tabernacle of the Lord will die.
cases.explain: The preposition к (toward / up to) takes the dative → скинии.

reading.ru: Среди них был и жезл Аарона.
reading.question: Whose rod was among the twelve rods?
reading.explain: The text notes that Aaron's rod was among them.

reading.ru: Моисей положил жезлы перед Господом в шатер свидетельства.
reading.question: Where did Moses place the rods?
options: In the tent of the testimony before the Lord
reading.correct: In the tent of the testimony before the Lord
reading.explain: Moses laid the rods before the Lord in the tent of the testimony.

reading.ru: Жезл моего избранника даст ростки, и я прекращу нескончаемый ропот израилетян на вас.
reading.question: What sign would identify the Lord's chosen one?
options: His name would be written in fire
reading.explain: The Lord said the rod of the man He chooses would sprout, ending the people's murmuring.

reading.ru: На другой день Моисей вошел в шатер свидетельства и увидел, что жезл Аарона, который представлял дом Левия, не только дал ростки, но и выпустил почки, расцвел и принес миндаль.
reading.question: What had happened to Aaron's rod by the next day?
options: It had sprouted, budded, blossomed and produced almonds
It had been broken in two
reading.correct: It had sprouted, budded, blossomed and produced almonds
reading.explain: The rod had sprouted, put out buds, blossomed and borne almonds.

reading.ru: Моисей сделал точно так, как повелел ему Господь.
reading.question: How did Moses carry out the instructions?
options: Exactly as the Lord commanded him
reading.correct: Exactly as the Lord commanded him
reading.explain: Moses did precisely as the Lord had commanded him.

reading.ru: Любой, кто даже приблизится к скинии Господа, умрет.
reading.question: What did the frightened Israelites fear would happen?
options: Anyone approaching the tabernacle would die
reading.correct: Anyone approaching the tabernacle would die
reading.explain: The people feared that anyone who even approached the Lord's tabernacle would die.
